_doc: ⚑ S205 — 2003's TESTIMONY (his 2026-09-30/10-01: 'expanding 2003… Daniel is requested to come and film his testimony to comply with its evangelisation needs… maybe that's one of the ways he met Caleb'; his research 'Yes — the testimony layer is historically…' and his answers: all five, in order; they meet AGAIN at the shoot — they knew each other at New Morning in 1997, his song is from its last night; silent footage with subtitles; no webcam for now). The 2003 thesis, from that research: 1997 the network finds you; 2003 the network turns you into media. The life cycle: his record → his words → the ministry's story → the ministry's media object → a doorway for somebody else. REGISTER: the program's surfaces (the sheet, the release, the editor, the page) are OPERABLE — the seller's voice, which collapses on its own terms; the footage is the people's and stays BARE — no mechanics in it, nothing scored, nothing narrated; the tape simply keeps running after the producer says cut. Documented vs reconstructed (his research's table; the dossier card says it): testimony as public evidence, conference and advertising testimony, VHS/DVD documentaries for churches, ministry testimony pages by 2005, a participant later rejecting the meaning attached to his filmed story — DOCUMENTED; the question sheet, the release's wording, word-for-word coaching — NOT FOUND, composites, labelled so. Every mark is invented (Restorify Media, the fellowship, MediaPlay, the URL); no real person, film or ministry on screen. Text is Claude's under the 2026-08-17 norm; his edit wins.
